data.title: 欧根亲王 · 百花旗袍的烛光回眸
data.description: 古典雅致的中式包厢内，红烛暖光映照着雕花木屏。欧根亲王身穿一袭精雕细琢的黑色百花刺绣高开衩旗袍，修长丰满的黑丝长腿侧坐于红木椅上。银白长发挽起一部分，红色挑染随风掠过胸口深V领口。她指尖轻抚酒杯边缘，眼角那颗标志性的泪痣在烛光下娇艳欲滴，带着坏笑向你投来无法拒绝的挑逗目光。
data.action: seated on carved mahogany armchair, black embroidered high-slit cheongsam, black stockings, mole under eye illuminated by candlelight, holding porcelain sake cup, teasing seductive smile
data.location: vintage oriental banquet parlor with red lanterns and carved screens
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight and deep crimson lantern glow
data.mood: intoxicating oriental seduction, irresistible playful dominance
data.promptProse: Sitting on an antique mahogany chair, Prinz Eugen looks over her shoulder in a high-slit black embroidered cheongsam and sheer stockings. Warm candlelight illuminates her beauty mark and crimson hair streak as she smiles playfully.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen sitting in a high-slit black cheongsam in candlelight, smiling teasingly.
